testimonials.author: Jeff Willie
testimonials.text:
Cody Roberts is an ultimate professional, transparent, honest, and totally focused on the homeowner’s needs.

6/29/26
From the moment Arturo Moreno arrived at my home, he was professional, courteous, and knowledgeable. He took the time to answered all of my questions, his attention to detail, technical expertise, and commitment to doing the job right were evident throughout the entire service visit.

Exceptional customer service is becoming increasingly rare, and Arturo exceeded my expectations. He represents Milestone with professionalism, integrity, and genuine care for the customer.

I highly recommend both Arturo and Milestone for anyone needing honest, high-quality HVAC service. Thank you for a job well done!

7/30/26
Dayton Gallagher, the ultimate professional. Very high standards that represent the Milestone Brand. The heart of Milestone is people first, family first which is extremely rare for a large company. Service technicians like Dayton Gallagher is the heart of your company.

testimonials.author: Mandana Shahbazi
testimonials.text: I had an excellent experience with this technician/Mr.  Brett Conway . He was professional, knowledgeable, respectful, and took the time to explain everything clearly without any pressure. He went above and beyond by cleaning both AC units and making sure I understood what he found and what was worth addressing versus what wasn’t. What stood out most wasn’t just his technical skill, but his character. He communicated with kindness, patience, and genuine professionalism. He has the qualities of someone who will make an outstanding leader in this company. I hope his hard work and dedication are recognized because employees like him are rare. Thank you again for such exceptional service.

testimonials.author: Farrah Carlton
testimonials.text: Ryan with Milestone was outstanding! He communicated clearly throughout the entire process, took the time to explain the issue and my options in a way that was easy to understand, and was incredibly respectful of my home. He was professional, knowledgeable, and made a stressful plumbing situation much easier to deal with. I really appreciated his honesty and great customer service. Highly recommend Ryan and the Milestone team!

testimonials.author: Rakesh Panchal
testimonials.text: We had a great experience with Clayton Berry Hill from Milestone! He provided top-notch AC service, explained the issue clearly, and patiently answered all of our follow-up questions. Best of all, he didn't try to oversell us on anything we didn't need. Highly recommend!

testimonials.author: James Kerr
testimonials.text: Milestone is a great brand and their techs are always courteous, affable, and professional.  They explain the work, execute with precision , and are worth the money spent. Shout out to Hiram for the repair of our air conditioning.  He even had a video clip of the work done. Didn't have an iPhone so he couldn't send me a link to it but says it Is in my file. The whole process was great and I'm back in cool air! Thanks!
